answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as a faint echo: a signal present but untested. Standing grows through many epochs, each verified contribution adding pulse to a collective record threaded with saffron markers of earned trust. Because voting weight follows witnessed tenure rather than key count, synthetic accounts remain echoes while genuine contributors carry real pulse.
